findings.quote: in twelve days Vesk had watched for the thing that men like him were supposed to have and had not seen it once
findings.problem: Time-elapsed contradiction: 'in twelve days' vs 'Eleven days he had watched for it. The twelfth had started at the second division' two sentences later; notes fix eleven.
findings.fix: Change 'in twelve days Vesk had watched' to 'in eleven days Vesk had watched'.

findings.quote: Foss came, with the glass in his fist and an expression he did not trouble to arrange.
findings.problem: 'did not trouble to arrange' asserts Foss's inner effort, not a cue Vesk can see (R39-7/R5-C1).
findings.fix: Rephrase as an observable face read by Vesk, or cut the clause.

findings.quote: He put two fingers against the ninth hind's flank, above the pour, and pressed.
findings.problem: Ambiguous 'He' (Malphas vs Vesk); if Malphas, 'the way a man checks...' states his motive, which Vesk cannot know.
findings.fix: Name the actor; if Malphas, hedge the gloss as Vesk's guess.

findings.quote: Eleven days of the ferment had taken the connective net out of her
findings.problem: Figure in bare narration against the brief's numbers protocol; R12-5/R14-4 may only bind stat figures, so a doubt.
findings.fix: Confirm scope, or route the count through a mouth, document or private count.

findings.quote: Then she will not need four days. Eleven feet is all she needs.
findings.problem: 'Eleven feet' to the standpipe is unattested invention (source's figure is eleven miles).
findings.fix: Accept as chapter invention and log it as a fact, or soften.

findings.quote: The one their Wardens of Duty are issued. Not the published articles.
findings.problem: Warden of Duty is a Guild-wide Tier-6 rank, not Arbitration-specific; manual issue unattested.
findings.fix: Reword so the manual is the division's, not tied to the rank.

findings.quote: Behind him Malphas said nothing at all. He did that most days and Vesk had never once been able to read it.
findings.problem: H08 plant half-missing: Malphas never registers Nuvalik's concealment or 'will discuss with her separately'.
findings.fix: Add a legible Malphas beat on the lie, or the 'separately' line.
